title: EnCarAPI - Korean & Chinese used car data

apiKey.title: EnCarAPI or ChinaCarAPI key
apiKey.description: Your API key from https://encarapi.com (Korea) or https://chinacarapi.com (China). EnCarAPI keys with the China add-on work for both markets. Without a key the Actor only returns a demo item explaining how to get one.

market.title: Market
market.description: Korea: Encar, KB Chachacha, K Car. China: Dongchedi, Che168.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Search listings, or fetch full details for a list of vehicle ids.

koreaSource.title: Korean marketplace
koreaSource.description: Encar is included in every plan. KB Chachacha, K Car and the deduplicated union depend on your plan (see encarapi.com/#pricing).

manufacturer.title: Brand
manufacturer.description: English brand name, e.g. Hyundai, Kia, Genesis, BMW. Comma-separated = OR.

modelGroup.title: Model
modelGroup.description: Model line, e.g. Sorento, Grandeur, 5 Series.

maxPriceManwon.title: Max price (10,000 KRW)
maxPriceManwon.description: Korean prices are in 만원: 3000 = 30,000,000 KRW.

frameClean.title: Accident-free chassis only
frameClean.description: Only cars with a clean chassis frame.

chinaSource.title: Chinese marketplace
chinaSource.description: Dongchedi, Che168 or both (duplicates across the two are removed). The free Dev plan covers Dongchedi only. In details mode this picks the marketplace for ids that exist on both.

chinaMake.title: Brand (China)
chinaMake.description: English brand name, e.g. BYD, Toyota.

chinaCity.title: City (China)
chinaCity.description: City where the car is offered, as listed in /api/enums (cities[].value, e.g. 上海 for Shanghai).

chinaFuel.title: Fuel (China)
chinaFuel.description: Fuel type in English or Chinese, e.g. Petrol, Electric, Plug-in hybrid (see /api/enums).

exportReady.title: Export-ready only
exportReady.description: Only Chinese cars that can be exported now.

chinaHasReport.title: With inspection report only
chinaHasReport.description: Only Chinese cars that have an inspection report.

vehicleIds.title: Vehicle ids (details mode)
vehicleIds.description: Ids from a search. Korea: Encar id, kbc:<id> or kcar:<id>. China: the Dongchedi or Che168 listing id (set Chinese marketplace for ids that exist on both).
